curated.lethality_detail_zh: 偏头痛本身极少直接致死，但属全球致残率最高的神经系统疾病之一；极少数可并发偏头痛性脑梗死或持续状态，若突然出现“一生中最剧烈爆炸样头痛”伴发热、颈强直或偏瘫，需立即排查蛛网膜下腔出血或脑卒中而非当作普通偏头痛。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 虽尚无根治手段，但可通过急性期止痛（曲普坦类、口服CGRP受体拮抗剂瑞美吉泮）与预防性治疗（CGRP单抗依瑞奈尤单抗/加卡奈珠单抗、β受体阻滞剂、托吡酯等）将多数患者的每月头痛天数减少50%以上，显著恢复工作与生活质量。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO与IHME GBD均未将偏头痛单列为直接死因，其核心疾病负担体现为高致残寿命年（YLD），居全球50岁以下人群致残原因首位
annual_deaths_global.source: IHME GBD 2021 / WHO Headache Disorders Fact Sheet

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国国家死因监测未单列偏头痛直接死亡统计

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球约11.6亿–12亿例患者，女性患病率约为男性的2倍，30–44岁青壮年负担最重（IHME GBD 2021）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国成人偏头痛年患病率约9.3%，患者总数估计超过1.3亿–1.5亿例（GBD 2021及中国流调）

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 靶向CGRP通路已彻底改变偏头痛治疗格局，瑞美吉泮（口服口崩片）、依瑞奈尤单抗、加卡奈珠单抗及瑞玛奈珠单抗均已在中国获批；2) 靶向PACAP（垂体腺苷酸环化酶激活肽）单抗（如Lu AG09222）在2期临床中显著减少每月偏头痛天数，为CGRP无应答患者带来新希望。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 约30%–40%患者对现有CGRP靶向药应答不足，亟需PACAP等新靶点药物；2) 患者长期自行滥用复方止痛药导致“药物过度使用性头痛”比例极高，基层规范化诊疗普及不足；3) 妊娠期及儿童青少年偏头痛缺乏高安全性循证预防方案。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: A mantle cell lymphoma occurring in the spleen.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: Trigeminal neuralgia is a nerve disorder that causes a stabbing or electric-shock-like pain in parts of the face. The pain lasts a few seconds to a few minutes, and usually on only one side of the face. It can also cause muscle spasms in the face the same time as the pain. The pain may result from a blood vessel pressing against the trigeminal nerve (the nerve that carries pain, feeling, and other sensations from the brain to the skin of theface), as a complication of multiple sclerosis, or due to compression of the nerve by a tumor or cyst. In some cases, the cause is unknown. Treatment options include medicines, surgery, and complementary approaches.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 三叉神经痛本身不直接致死，但每次数秒至两分钟的电击刀割样剧痛因洗脸、刷牙、说话或吹风即可触发，被称为“天下第一痛”；若长期误诊拔牙或控制不佳，患者极易出现严重进食营养不良及重度抑郁自杀倾向。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 约70%–80%初发患者对卡马西平或奥卡西平反应良好；对于药物耐药或无法耐受头晕/低钠/剥脱性皮炎副作用者，微血管减压术（MVD）可针对血管压迫病因实现70%–80%以上长期无痛缓解。

curated.category: 遗传性基底膜胶原肾病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 负责搭建肾脏滤过膜（肾小球基底膜）“钢筋骨架”的IV型胶原基因（COL4A5约占80%为X连锁遗传，COL4A3/COL4A4为常染色体遗传）发生突变，导致基底膜像年久失修的破墙一样变薄、分层撕裂; 2) 患儿常自幼即有持续镜下血尿，逐渐出现蛋白尿、进行性感音神经性耳聋（高频听力下降）及圆锥形晶状体等眼部病变; 3) 男性X连锁与常染色体隐性患者若未早期干预，绝大多数在20–30岁青壮年期即进展至尿毒症。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 虽然目前尚无法修复受损的IV型胶原基因，但早期（甚至仅出现微量蛋白尿前的高危期）即开始终生足量口服ACEI/ARB类肾保护药（如雷米普利），可将男性患者进入尿毒症的平均年龄推迟15–20年以上，让患者顺利完成学业成家并大大延长原生肾脏寿命。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE未单列Alport综合征死因；占全球儿童及青壮年终末期肾病透析/移植人群的约1%–3%

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国尚无全国单列死亡登记；国内儿科及肾内科基因诊断普及后，COL4A3/4/5突变已成为中国不明原因血尿与家族性肾病最常见基因病因
annual_deaths_china.source: 中华医学会肾脏病学分会 / 《Alport综合征诊治专家共识（2023版）》

non_drug_therapies_zh: 家系级联筛查与基因检测：先证者所有父母、同胞及子女必须行尿常规（查潜血/蛋白尿）及COL4A3/COL4A4/COL4A5基因检测（包括X连锁女性携带者同样有终生慢性肾病风险，不可忽视随访）；育龄夫妇可通过三代试管（PGT-M）阻断遗传
早期并定期行纯音测听与眼科裂隙灯检查，听力下降及早配戴助听器避免儿童语言发育受损
禁用肾毒性药物（氨基糖苷类抗生素既伤肾又伤耳，绝对禁用）及避免剧烈脱水性运动
进展至尿毒症后行肾移植效果极佳（移植肾具有正常IV型胶原，仅极少数X连锁男性患者术后可能发生抗GBM抗体反应）
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 早期口服雷米普利+SGLT2i及定期尿检听力随访年费用约2,000–4,500元人民币；若进展至尿毒症透析或肾移植，费用同慢性肾衰（年透析约8万–12万元）

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2023–2024年Alport综合征临床研究聚焦抗纤维化与降蛋白新靶点：1) 抗miR-21寡核苷酸Lademirsen 2期临床（2024年CJASN发表）证实耐受性良好但未显著减缓eGFR下降，提示单纯抗miR-21不足以逆转胶原结构缺陷; 2) 高选择性NOX1/4抑制剂Setanaxib（2023年获FDA/EMA孤儿药资格）及内皮素受体拮抗剂Atrasentan（AFFINITY研究Alport队列）正推进2期临床评估; 3) 2024年国际Alport共识明确将常染色体杂合携带者也纳入早期RAAS阻断监测体系。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 尚无获批药物或基因疗法能直接修复或替换突变的COL4A3/4/5 IV型胶原三螺旋结构; 2) 女性X连锁携带者常被误认为“无害携带者”而漏掉尿检随访，部分人在中老年仍进展至肾衰; 3) 进行性感音神经性耳聋目前除助听器/人工耳蜗外无药物可逆转。

master.definition_en: Chromosome 20 trisomy, (also called trisomy 20) is a condition in which a fetus or individual has an extra full or partial copy of chromosome 20 in some or allof of his/her cells. An extra full copy of chromosome 20 in all of a person's cells is rare, and almost all fetuses with this do not survive past the first trimester ofpregnancy. The presence of an extra copyof only part of chromosome 20 is called partial trisomy 20; and an extra copy of chromosome 20 in only some of a person's cells is called mosaic trisomy 20. Mosaic trisomy 20 is the most common type of chromosome 20 trisomy and is one of the more common chromosomal abnormalities found during prenatal diagnostic testing. Studies have shown that the child is normal in the vast majority of prenatally diagnosed individuals. However, features that have been reported include spinal abnormalities (including spinal stenosis, vertebral fusion, and kyphosis), hypotonia (decreased muscle tone), life long constipation, sloped shoulders, and significant learning disabilities despite normal intelligence. Trisomy 20 usually results from an error that occurs when an egg or sperm cell develops (before fertilization); mosaic trisomy 20 usually results from errors in cell division soon after fertilization.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.definition_en: A rare vascular liver disease characterized by the absence of cirrhosis with or without portal hypertension and histological lesions involving portal venules or sinusoids. Patients may present either with specific clinical signs of portal hypertention (including gastric esophageal or ectopic varices, portal hypertensive bleeding or porto-systemic collaterals at imaging) or a histological lesion specific to portosinusoidal vascular disease (including obliterative portal venopathy, nodular regenerative hyperplasmia or incomplete septal fibrosis or cirrhosis) or they may manifest clinical signs that are not specific to portal hypertention (such as ascites, platelet count <150.000/µl, increased spleen size ≥13 cm in the largest axis) together with a histological lesion including portal tract abnormalities, irregular distribution of the portal tracts and central veins, non-zonal sinusoidal dilation, mild perisinusoidal fibrosis. Possible associations with altered immunity, hematological diseases and prothrombotic conditions, infections, congenital or familial defects, or drug exposure are reported.
